items.title: Early months: research
items.detail: Understand countries, courses and budget. Make a long list.

items.title: Then: tests
items.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE or GRE. Book a date and start preparing.

items.title: After that: SOP and LOR
items.detail: Write drafts, and ask your recommenders early.

items.title: Then: applications
items.detail: List the deadlines and submit them one by one.

youtube.title: New year, study abroad plan? A simple year-long roadmap
youtube.description:
Your study abroad plan for the new year: research and shortlist first, then tests, after that SOP and LOR, and then applications. Check every university's deadline on its official site.
